title: Integrate ACE-Step LoRA and DoRA-row training across GPU backends
design: Port the SA3 GGML training patch stack onto ACE-Step's newer GGML pin. Route every ACE-Step DiT linear projection through an optional functional adapter transform. Apply LoRA and DoRA-row normalization without materializing effective weights; support fused-weight views.
acceptance_criteria: CPU forward/backward numerical gradient test passes. CUDA, Vulkan, and Metal execute the training graph with quantized frozen weights. Trainer saves/resumes and emits PEFT-compatible adapter artifacts. Tiny real dataset slice overfits and reloads into inference. Unadapted inference remains unchanged.
notes: Sawhee source import is committed at 3fc27a5. Verified current sa3.cpp pin ba817aa is the v0.16.0 source provenance, while tested Sawhee GGML 7ccc6df is its ACE-base rebase. The exact GGML ref exists locally as ggml/acestep-training for publication in twilwa/sawhee. Added a free 25-minute CUDA 12.6 compile job; GitHub T4 runtime is unavailable to this personal repo and larger runners are paid. Imported root builds on Metal; CPU and MTL0 DoRA graphs pass F32/Q8_0/Q4_K/Q5_K/Q6_K; the 10-second Drive slice validates.

title: Disable inference-only flash attention in native training graphs
notes: Reproduced with official Q8_0 DiT and the 10-second Drive slice on MTL0. Preprocessing completes; production ace-train aborts in ggml_build_backward_expand because the full training graph contains FLASH_ATTN_EXT, which has no backward implementation.
close_reason: Real Q8 Metal training completed after forcing backward-compatible manual attention; regression preserves inference flash-attention setting.
